gates.description: suite_schema MUST equal CS-0@3.0.1 across contract, gates, and manifest.
gates.failure_message: Bundle suite_schema drift detected; API-0 artifacts are not aligned to CS-0@3.0.1.
gates.title: Bundle suite schema parity

gates.description: bundle.manifest.json filename and manifest file inventory MUST match the actual bundle contents exactly.
gates.failure_message: Manifest filename or manifest file inventory does not match the actual bundle contents.
gates.title: Manifest filename and contents

gates.description: The contract artifact MUST retain API-0 doc_id and version 1.2.0.
gates.failure_message: Contract doc_id or version drift detected.
gates.title: Contract identity parity

gates.description: The test gates artifact MUST retain API-0-GATE doc_id, version 1.2.0, and contract_ref parity to API-0@1.2.0.
gates.failure_message: Gate doc_id, version, or contract_ref drift detected.
gates.title: Gate identity and contract reference parity

gates.description: The API-0 canonical bundle MUST contain only contract, test gates, and manifest JSON artifacts; removed sidecars MUST not remain in the canonical bundle.
gates.failure_message: A removed sidecar artifact remains in the canonical API-0 bundle.
gates.title: Canonical three-artifact discipline

gates.description: API-0 owns the HTTP Idempotency-Key requirement, ERR-1 owns its error identifiers, and LOCKS-1 alone owns durable idempotency semantics; T0 does not delegate those semantics to EXT-1.
gates.failure_message: T0 idempotency authority is delegated to EXT-1 or conflicts with ERR-1/LOCKS-1.
gates.title: T0 idempotency authority ownership

authority_review_gates.description: Review the approved authority corrections in the paired versionless contract.json draft. Confirm the contract text contains no contradictory legacy lock for the corrected behavior.
authority_review_gates.failure_message: Approved authority correction or legacy contradiction remains unresolved.
